meta.name: My Dearest
meta.description: A love-story between a noblewoman and a mysterious man who shows up in her hometown set in the 1600s during the Qing invasion.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A stranger enters Neunggun-ri, a peaceful village where Gil-chae lives, and turns the village upside down.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Gil-chae gets help from Jang-hyun to learn about people in Hanyang, and he takes her to interesting places.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Yeon-jun and the scholars volunteer to fight for the country, while Jang-hyun plans to evacuate.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: When Gil-сhae and Eun-ae are about to flee from their village, the intruders arrive at Neunggun-ri.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Jang-hyun helps Yeon-jun as he gets injured. Meanwhile, the Crown Prince wants to ask Jang-hyun for help.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Since the King of Joseon does not come out from the fortress, Khan conquers Ganghwa Island.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Yeon-jun is about to propose to Eun-ae. Yeon-jun and Gil-chae have a private chat for the last time.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Jang-hyun and his friends leave Joseon with the Crown Prince and meet Yong Gol-dae in Simyang.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Jang-hyun captures fleeing prisoners in Simyang, while Gil-chae runs a business to make a living.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Jang-hyun returns to Joseon and finds out Gil-chae is engaged to another man.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: While capturing fleeing prisoners from Joseon, Jang-hyun meets familiar people.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Gil-chae and Jong-jong get captured and dragged to Qing while trying to help Da-jim.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Won-moo travels to Simyang to bring Gil-chae back. Jang-hyun meets the princess of the Qing in Simyang.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Jang Hyun meets Gil-chae at the slave market in Simyang and saves her from the merchant.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Gil-chae stays in Simyang until Jang-hyun gets better, but Ryang-eum wants her gone as soon as possible.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Gil-chae wants to stay in Simyang, but Jang-hyun sends her back to Joseon for her safety.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Jang-hyun returns to Joseon with the Crown Prince, and the King is afraid his son will take over his place.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: The King of Joseon banned the Crown Prince from bringing back the captives to Joseon.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Gil-chae secretly takes Jang-hyun home, and the eunuchs from the palace are searching everywhere to find him.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Jang-hyun finds out the Crown Prince left a letter for him. Gak-hwa looks for Jang-hyun at Gil-chae's house.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: As His Majesty's men hunt down the captives on the run, Jang-hyun sends Gil-chae away and turns to face them.

meta.slogan: My dearest whom I miss and love very much
